$comment: Repo-level OpenRouter configuration, read by dating/harness/llm_backends.py.
Decisions and evidence are in the `rationale` block; re-review when models change (last_reviewed).
The account enforces Zero Data Retention: every request also sets provider.zdr=true and only ZDR endpoints are considered when choosing models.
`roles.<role>.claude` selects Anthropic/Claude Agent models; `roles.<role>.codex` selects Codex models and reasoning effort. All backends share prompts and schemas.
`roles.<role>.backend` selects the backend for that role (openrouter | anthropic | claude-agent | codex); DATING_LLM_BACKEND overrides all roles.
historical_selection_rationale_2026_09_17 and rationale.evidence are retained historical notes, not current dating-quality validation; see dating_evaluation_review.

screen.why: Provisional inexpensive screening assignment. Validate relevant-source recall, especially corrections, critiques and sources without numeric dates, before accepting exclusions.

claude.why: same role on the Anthropic API / Claude Agent SDK backends

screen.historical_selection_rationale_2026_09_1: thousands of ~500-token title+abstract calls; the cheapest model with a real reasoning score (AA 42, Arena 1475) on fp8 ZDR endpoints at $0.15/$0.50
screen.validation_status: provisional; dating role-specific accuracy not measured

extract.why: Provisional extraction assignment; model tier has not been validated on dating semantics. Quote matching does not verify event, entity, epoch, role, completeness or scenario attribution. Compare against a capable reasoning baseline on identical complete inputs before optimizing cost.

claude.why: same role on the Anthropic API / Claude Agent SDK backends; Sonnet 5 is the input-cost tier ($2/$10) with 1M context

extract.historical_selection_rationale_2026_09_1: input-dominated (10k–200k tokens per paper); Arena 1493 / AA 41 at $0.75/$3.75 on Google ZDR endpoints with implicit caching and 1M context; quote verification by the harness catches extraction errors, so the flash tier is the right cost/quality point
extract.validation_status: provisional; dating role-specific accuracy not measured

synthesize.why: Provisional reasoning-intensive review assignment; proposals cannot adopt evidence. Evaluate scenario/dependency fidelity and abstention separately from extraction. Effective backend and fallbacks must be recorded; role model name alone does not identify the executed model.

claude.why: same role on the Anthropic API / Claude Agent SDK backends

synthesize.historical_selection_rationale_2026_09_1: one reasoning-heavy call per family over all claims. Default backend is the Claude Agent SDK (Opus 5, effort high, on the Claude subscription: Arena 1493, AA 48–51, no per-token cost). On OpenRouter the ZDR endpoints for Opus 5 (Vertex/Bedrock) do not support strict structured outputs, so the API path uses GPT-6 Astra (AA 53, Arena 1480, $10/$50 on Azure ZDR).
synthesize.validation_status: provisional; dating role-specific accuracy not measured

constraints: ZDR enforcement (account-wide) means only endpoints listed by GET /api/v1/endpoints/zdr are reachable: e.g. Anthropic models only via Vertex/Bedrock, OpenAI only via Azure, no anthropic/claude-fable-5.1, no qwen/qwen3.8-flash or -max, no meta/muse-spark-1.3.
Structured outputs are required (response_format json_schema strict); provider.require_parameters=true keeps routing on endpoints that honour it.
Open-weight models are served by many providers at different quantizations; fp4/int4 endpoints are excluded by provider.quantizations, remaining endpoints are sorted by price.

Do not send `temperature`: reasoning endpoints (Google Vertex, Azure OpenAI) do not list it in supported_parameters, and with provider.require_parameters=true that silently routes every request to the last fallback. Structured outputs + effort are the determinism levers instead.

Anthropic models on the ZDR endpoints (Vertex, Bedrock) list response_format but not structured_outputs, so strict json_schema requests cannot route to them; use the anthropic or claude-agent backends for Claude models.
efficiency: Caching: stable system prompt first, per-item content last; Anthropic models get an explicit cache_control breakpoint on the system message; Gemini/DeepSeek/GLM cache implicitly. session_id = family so sticky routing keeps a task on one endpoint (cache hits).
Batching: extraction and screening are latency-insensitive; `--batch` submits them to POST /api/beta/batches on the :batch model variant at 50% price with a 24h window, same request bodies.
Fallbacks: `models` lists the fallbacks so a 5xx/429 on the primary is retried on the next model without a round trip to us.
usage.include=true returns cost per request, logged next to every call for the reproducibility record.

claude_agent.why: the Claude Agent SDK runs on a Claude subscription with 5-hour/weekly usage windows; on a `rejected` rate-limit event or a 429 result the backend waits until resets_at (capped) and retries — every stage writes progress as it goes, so an interrupted run resumes where it stopped. Set on_usage_limit to `fallback` to continue on OpenRouter (paid) instead, or `fail` to stop.

codex.why: Opt-in ChatGPT subscription backend via codex exec. Run codex login first; API-key logins are rejected, environment API keys are excluded, and errors/usage limits fail without paid fallback. Role assignments are provisional and not dating-quality validated. Set auth_credentials_store to keyring or auto if that is where your Codex login is stored.

dating_evaluation_review.reason: Observed pilot defects motivate role-specific evaluation, but are not an attributed model-error-rate comparison.
